fact: As of 10 May 2023 the Ministry of ICT and Postal Services' World Bank-financed Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project allots US$8 million of IDA money to last-mile connectivity, including service contracts with commercial operators to connect public institutions along fibre routes (government offices, schools, hospitals), and the document records the lack of a consolidated digital government strategy; it names no county or local government office.
title: Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF): Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project (P176181)
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services (MICT&PS), Republic of South Sudan
